name: Chipped Border Garnet
desc: Adds raw physical bite to blades or thickens vitality in plate.
flavor: Dug from gravel bars along the Redwater ford.

name: Cloudy Fen Beryl
desc: Sharpens aim on weapons or expands mana reserves in robes.
flavor: Polished by Lantern Passage scribes to read damp ink.

name: Bog-Dredged Amber
desc: Coats strikes in venom or wards armor against marsh-rot.
flavor: Traps prehistoric gnats inside warm golden resin.

name: Alder River Jade
desc: Quickens weapon swings or lightens boots on muddy roads.
flavor: Carved by Thornwick river-pilots as a charm against drowning.

name: Wardstone Quartz
desc: Charges strikes with static or grounds armor against arcs.
flavor: Splintered from a ruptured Redmarsh climate monolith.

name: Quarry Bloodstone
desc: Siphons vigor on hit or knits torn sinew in armor.
flavor: Flecked with crimson iron-oxide from the Deep Quarry.

name: Glacier-Core Sapphire
desc: Chills foes on strike or insulates mail against sea-frost.
flavor: Brought south by whalers wrecked on the Iron Coast.

name: Caldera Cinder-Ruby
desc: Ignites weapon blows or turns aside volcanic heat.
flavor: Pulled from cooling magma vents below Greystone Bastion.

name: Tide-Mirror Opal
desc: Adds armor-ignoring astral force or steadies focus.
flavor: Shifts color like deep harbor water before a squall.

name: Magnetic Lodestone
desc: Punches through plate seams or reinforces shield rims.
flavor: Quarried from the iron-veined cliffs of the Gauntlet.

name: Pre-Schism Diamond
desc: Finds fatal gaps in armor or wards against every element.
flavor: Cut before the First Cataclysm by blind Oakhaven jewelers.

name: Heart of the Anchor
desc: Channels primordial ember into steel or sovereign plate.
flavor: Pulsing volcanic glass salvaged from the Obsidian Dais.

name: Rune of Tally (Tal)
desc: Marks every fallen foe on the ledger or eases long marches.
flavor: First glyph taught to Thornwick toll-clerks.

name: Rune of Iron (Kor)
desc: Hardens weapon edges or reinforces riveted mail.
flavor: Stamped onto bridge-guard pikes by Master Hobb.

name: Rune of Draught (Ven)
desc: Draws ambient aether or amplifies apothecary salves.
flavor: Inscribed on Widow Marta's copper distillation stills.

name: Rune of Silt (Silt)
desc: Bogs down struck targets or helps scouts slip past blows.
flavor: Copied from sunken boundary steles in Redmarsh.

name: Rune of Gale (Gale)
desc: Accelerates strikes or deflects incoming arrows.
flavor: Chiseled into Oakhaven lighthouse stones.

name: Rune of Lien (Lien)
desc: Compounds lingering debts or extends hex bindings.
flavor: Used by coastal abbey arbiters to seal deathbed wills.

name: Rune of Ward (Ward)
desc: Banishes bound horrors or shields against dark rituals.
flavor: Carved above the doors of the Sunken Sanctum.

name: Rune of Slag (Slag)
desc: Shatters fractured armor or thickens bastion plate.
flavor: Quenched in meteor-slag at Forgemaster Vok's hearth.

name: Rune of Oath (Oath)
desc: Empowers bound watchmen or strengthens squad banners.
flavor: Etched onto the brass name-plates of the First Watch.

name: Rune of Flux (Flux)
desc: Cycles invocations faster or conserves arcane reserves.
flavor: Decoded from Arch-Mage Malrik's forbidden ley-notes.

name: Rune of Order (Crown)
desc: Purges corruption with star-iron or fortifies against lords.
flavor: Struck from the celestial alloy of the Crown of Order.

name: Rune of Ember (Ash)
desc: Feeds on the fallen or turns armor into a living furnace.
flavor: Brand of the Obsidian Throne that answers only to will.
